breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines and applies the factor of safety as n = Sy / σ_avg (275 MPa / 21.22 MPa ≈ 12.96), with the yield strength in the numerator and the working stress in the denominator. It does not repeat the incorrect inverted definition (σ_avg / S_y) from the incomplete prompt.
